scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,dash,ext -c yellow,magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @phantom/shared" "npm run dev -w @phantom/api" "npm run dev -w @phantom/dashboard" "npm run dev -w @phantom/extension"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @phantom/shared && npm run build -w @phantom/api && npm run build -w @phantom/dashboard && npm run build -w @phantom/extension
scripts.build:extension:store: npm run build -w @phantom/shared && npm run build -w @phantom/extension
